data.name: Jaari
data.gender_notes: Jaari is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘jarrah’ meaning fresh or young. This name embodies the spirit of renewal and vitality. The name Jaari carries the meaning “Youth, freshness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaari usually hope their child will grow to embody youth, freshness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the continuous journey of spiritual growth and development.
data.etymology: Jaari belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youth, freshness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaari total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: جاري
in_arabic.meaning: جاري تعني مستمر أو دائم في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: جاري هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ج-ر-ي' والذي يعني التدفق أو السير. في اللغة العربية، يعني جاري المستمر أو الدائم. وقد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَجَارٍ غَيْرِ مَجرُورٍ' (سورة الواقعة: 93). يعتبر اسم جاري ذا دلالة روحية و معنوية عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى استمرارية و دوام النعم الإلهية.

in_urdu.name: جاری
in_urdu.meaning: جاری مطلب ہے جاری رہنے والا یا دائم
in_urdu.long_meaning: جاری ایک عربی نام ہے جو جذر 'ج-ر-ي' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بہنا یا چلنا۔ اردو میں، جاری کا مطلب ہے وہ جو جاری رہتا ہے یا دائم ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، جہاں یہ دائم برکات اور غیر متغیر فضل الٰہی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जारी
in_hindi.meaning: जारी का अर्थ है लगातार या स्थायी
in_hindi.long_meaning: जारी एक अरबी नाम है जो 'ज-र-य' जड़ से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रवाह या चलना। हिंदी में, जारी का अर्थ है लगातार या स्थायी। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्व रखता है, जहां यह निरंतर आशीर्वाद और ईश्वर की कृपा की प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: جاري
in_pashto.meaning: جاري د دوام یا پرله پسې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: جاري د عربي نوم دی چې د 'ج-ر-ي' جذر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د تګ یا روانېدو معنی لري. په پښتو کې، جاري د دوام یا پرله پسې معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو کې ځای لري، چیرته چې دا د دوامداره برکت او الهي فضل نښه ده.

in_english.name: Jaari
in_english.meaning: Jaari means continuous, lasting, or permanent
in_english.long_meaning: Jaari is an Arabic name derived from the root 'j-r-y', which signifies flow or movement. In English, Jaari translates to continuous, lasting, or permanent. This name holds spiritual and cultural significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the enduring nature of divine blessings. Historically, the root 'j-r-y' appears in the Quran, emphasizing the ongoing and perpetual aspects of God's mercy and providence.

Children are often given names reflecting the desires and aspirations of their parents or the prophetic values held dear in their culture. The name Jaari, with its connotation of freshness and vitality, is a reminder of the importance of remaining rooted in the present moment and embracing the ongoing cycle of life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jaari can be seen as a reminder of the eternal renewal found in the inner journey towards self-discovery and relationship with the Divine. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, "Verily God loves those who are ever renewing their faith," (Bukhari). Thus, the name Jaari can serve as a constant reminder to always-rekindle one's faith, seek knowledge, growth, and self-betterment in order to cultivate a strong bond with the Divine. Just as a tree with fresh sap is strong and resilient, a spiritually rooted individual with renewed faith and determination is able to face life's challenges with courage and grace.
